title: Operator Shortcuts: Macrolets and contextual safety holster
creator: Marisol Vega
description: This ticket designs and implements 'macrolets' — compact operator shortcuts that encapsulate common triage flows as composable, permissioned microflows. Goal: reduce mean time to remediate by enabling first-line responders to run safe, parameterized micro-operations with built-in dry-run, audit logging, and automatic rollback. Macrolets are distinct from existing runbook fragments: they are intentionally small (1–5 steps), accept typed inputs, are policy-gated, and discoverable via the Ops Console quick-holster. Workstreams: 1) authoring DSL and manifest format; 2) sandboxed executor with checkpoint/undo and dry-run; 3) RBAC + KMS signature enforcement on manifests; 4) Console quick-holster UX and telemetry plumbing to the autofix recommender; 5) migration tooling (convert high-value runbooks to macrolets). Success metrics: 40% reduction in median time-to-remediate for targeted playbooks, <2% invalid-execution rate, and full audit provenance for every execution.
